subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Financial Autonomy: The Real Wealth
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Financial Autonomy: The Real Wealth.

hook.text: The richest feeling isn't a purchase. It's waking up with no obligations: no debt payments, no boss you hate, no.

buildup.text: Financial Autonomy sets up the incentives, biases, and tradeoffs driving the choice.

discovery.text: Money buys autonomy when it creates options: the ability to quit, move, wait, or say no.

twist.text: High earners with high spending have less autonomy than moderate earners with low expenses.

climax.text: Optimize for autonomy, not status. Every dollar saved is a dollar of future freedom.

punchline.text: Wealth means you can say 'no, thanks.' Build it.

quiz.question: What is the strongest predictor of life satisfaction from money?
options: Financial autonomy — control over time and choices
Earning more than all your peers
